title: Normalisation of the Euclidean coefficient norm: Σ_j α(f∘j)² = n!·|α|_E² for every orthonormal basis f
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let α be an n-covector on ℝ^P (a continuous alternating n-linear form, Covector (Euclid P) n) and let f = (f_0, …, f_{P−1}) be an orthonormal basis of ℝ^P indexed by Fin P. Then Σ_{j : Fin n → Fin P} α(f_{j(0)}, …, f_{j(n−1)})² = n!·|α|_E², where |α|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2} and e is the standard basis.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (f : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P)), ∑ j : Fin n → Fin P, (α (fun k => f (j k))) ^ 2 = (n.factorial : ℝ) * covectorEuclideanNorm α ^ 2
